name: Leodegrance

attributes.attribute: a person in the Arthur stories

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Leodebrance appears in the Arthurian tales. He is the father of Guinevere, the great beauty who became queen beside Arthur. Sources name him as Guinevere's father above other detail.

okr.objective: Place Leodegrance in the Arthur stories.
key_results: He is the father of the queen Guinevere.
He appears in the Arthurian tales.
